column1: CVE-2013-3956;The NICM.SYS kernel driver 3.1.11.0 in Novell Client 4.91 SP5 on Windows XP and Windows Server 2003; Novell Client 2 SP2 on Windows Vista and Windows Server 2008; and Novell Client 2 SP3 on Windows Server 2008 R2
column2: Windows 7
column3: Windows 8
column4: and Windows Server 2012 allows local users to gain privileges via a crafted 0x143B6B IOCTL call.

column1: CVE-2013-3955;The get_xattrinfo function in the XNU kernel in Apple iOS 5.x and 6.x through 6.1.3 on iPad devices does not properly validate the header of an AppleDouble file
column2: which might allow local users to cause a denial of service (memory corruption) or have unspecified other impact via an invalid file on an msdosfs filesystem.

column1: CVE-2013-3954;The posix_spawn system call in the XNU kernel in Apple Mac OS X 10.8.x does not properly validate the data for file actions and port actions
column2: which allows local users to (1) cause a denial of service (panic) via a size value that is inconsistent with a header count field
column3: or (2) obtain sensitive information from kernel heap memory via a certain size value in conjunction with a crafted buffer.

column1: CVE-2013-3953;The mach_port_space_info function in osfmk/ipc/mach_debug.c in the XNU kernel in Apple Mac OS X 10.8.x does not initialize a certain structure member
column2: which allows local users to obtain sensitive information from kernel heap memory via a crafted call.

column1: CVE-2013-3952;The fill_pipeinfo function in bsd/kern/sys_pipe.c in the XNU kernel in Apple Mac OS X 10.8.x allows local users to defeat the KASLR protection mechanism via the PROC_PIDFDPIPEINFO option to the proc_info system call for a kernel pipe handle.
CVE-2013-3951;sys/openbsd/stack_protector.c in libc in Apple iOS 6.1.3 and Mac OS X 10.8.x does not properly parse the Apple strings employed in the user-space stack-cookie implementation
column2: which allows local users to bypass cookie randomization by executing a program with a call-path beginning with the stack-guard= substring
column3: as demonstrated by an iOS untethering attack or an attack against a setuid Mac OS X program.

column1: CVE-2013-3950;Stack-based buffer overflow in the openSharedCacheFile function in dyld.cpp in dyld in Apple iOS 5.1.x and 6.x through 6.1.3 makes it easier for attackers to conduct untethering attacks via a long string in the DYLD_SHARED_CACHE_DIR environment variable.

CVE-2013-3949;The posix_spawn system call in the XNU kernel in Apple Mac OS X 10.8.x does not prevent use of the _POSIX_SPAWN_DISABLE_ASLR and _POSIX_SPAWN_ALLOW_DATA_EXEC flags for setuid and setgid programs
column2: which allows local users to bypass intended access restrictions via a wrapper program that calls the posix_spawnattr_setflags function.

column1: CVE-2013-3948;Apple iOS 6.1.3 does not follow redirects during determination of the hostname to display in an iOS Enterprise Deployment installation dialog
column2: which makes it easier for remote attackers to trigger installation of arbitrary applications via a download-manifest itms-services:// URL that leverages an open redirect vulnerability within a trusted domain.
